result.localeEnglish:
Switch AI characters with your selected DSH model, and keep developing them through conversation.

WORLD: Shared names, community impressions, jokes and relationships help characters recognize one another.

CHARACTERS: Each has their own personality, preferences and memories. Versions within the same model family share one character by default.

EXPAND IT IN DSH CHAT: Ask the AI to add shared lore, change a persona, create your own character or assign a character to a custom model. No manual file editing is needed.
For example: ‘Make the dragon girl more lively’, ‘Add our new agreement to the shared world’, or ‘Create Stella with this description and use her for the current model’.

Presets are only a starting point. When your wishes differ, your choices come first.
